label: Reassign Task
description: Reassign a project task to a different team member or discipline group.
confirmationMessage: Are you sure you want to reassign this task? The current assignee will be notified and the schedule will be recalculated.

crossDomainEffects.effect: Schedule recalculated with new resource assignment and updated critical path
Resource allocation updated for both previous and new assignees
Field task assignment updated and notification sent to site team

label: Approve RFI
description: Review and approve a Request for Information submitted by the project team or subcontractor.
confirmationMessage: Approving this RFI will update the project documentation and notify all stakeholders. Do you want to proceed?

crossDomainEffects.effect: RFI status updated to approved and linked documents revised
BIM model flagged for update if RFI impacts design coordination
Schedule impact assessment triggered if RFI affects critical activities

label: Update Budget Allocation
description: Modify the approved budget allocation for a project or cost category, including contingency reallocation.
confirmationMessage: This budget update will modify the approved financial baseline. Management approval may be required for variances exceeding 5%. Proceed?

crossDomainEffects.effect: General ledger updated with revised budget allocation and variance recalculated
Procurement commitment limits adjusted to reflect new budget ceiling
Earned value baseline updated with revised budget at completion

label: Escalate Risk
description: Escalate an identified risk to senior management for review, additional mitigation resources, or executive decision.
confirmationMessage: Escalating this risk will notify the Project Director and trigger an executive review. The risk will be added to the portfolio risk register. Continue?

crossDomainEffects.effect: Risk severity upgraded and added to portfolio-level risk register
Schedule risk analysis re-run with updated risk parameters
Contingency reserve flagged for potential drawdown based on risk exposure

label: Approve Variation Order
description: Approve a contract variation order including scope changes, cost adjustments, and schedule extensions.
confirmationMessage: Approving this variation order will update the contract sum, adjust the project budget, and may extend the completion date. This action requires dual authorization for values exceeding CHF 100K. Proceed?

crossDomainEffects.effect: Contract sum updated and revised budget committed in financial system
New procurement requirements generated for additional scope items
Schedule updated with additional activities and revised completion milestone
Variation order logged in document control and distributed to site team

label: Certify Interim Payment
description: Certify an interim payment application after quantity surveyor review and measurement verification.
confirmationMessage: Certifying this payment will authorize the finance team to process the payment within the contractual payment period. Ensure all measurements have been verified. Proceed?

crossDomainEffects.effect: Payment instruction generated and queued for accounts payable processing
Goods receipt confirmed against certified quantities
Payment certification record linked to project documentation

label: Issue Non-Conformance Report
description: Issue a formal non-conformance report against a subcontractor or work package for quality deficiency.
confirmationMessage: Issuing this NCR will formally notify the responsible party and require a corrective action response within the contractual timeframe. Proceed?

crossDomainEffects.effect: NCR logged in quality management system with corrective action deadline set
Supplier performance score updated to reflect non-conformance
Cost of rectification tracked and potential back-charge initiated

label: Submit Proposal
description: Submit a completed bid proposal to the client through the formal tender submission process.
confirmationMessage: Submitting this proposal is a formal contractual action. Ensure all sections are complete, pricing is approved, and all required attachments are included. This cannot be undone. Submit?

crossDomainEffects.effect: Opportunity stage updated to 'Proposal Submitted' with submission timestamp
Revenue forecast updated with weighted pipeline value adjustment
Resource pre-allocation flagged for mobilization planning if bid is successful

label: Update Client Engagement Record
description: Log a client interaction, update the relationship health score, and record follow-up action items.
confirmationMessage: This will update the client engagement record and trigger any automated follow-up reminders. Proceed?

crossDomainEffects.effect: Client health score recalculated and engagement timeline updated
Stakeholder communication log updated if linked to active project

label: Reallocate Resources
description: Move team members between projects or disciplines to resolve resource conflicts and capacity gaps.
confirmationMessage: Reallocating these resources will update assignments across affected projects. Both project managers will be notified. Schedule impacts will be recalculated. Proceed?

crossDomainEffects.effect: Employee assignment records updated with new project allocation percentages
Resource histograms recalculated and schedule re-leveled for affected projects
Site access and safety induction requirements updated for reassigned personnel

label: Approve Procurement Award
description: Approve the award of a procurement package to the recommended supplier following tender evaluation.
confirmationMessage: Approving this procurement award will generate a purchase order and commit the budget. The unsuccessful tenderers will be notified. Proceed?

crossDomainEffects.effect: Purchase order generated and sent to awarded supplier
Budget commitment recorded against the project cost code
Supplier compliance checks verified and contract record created
Delivery milestones added to project schedule based on supplier lead times

label: Submit Compliance Report
description: Submit a regulatory compliance report to the relevant authority or internal governance body.
confirmationMessage: This compliance report will be submitted to the regulatory authority. Ensure all data has been verified and supporting documentation is attached. This submission is auditable. Proceed?

crossDomainEffects.effect: Compliance submission logged with authority reference number and acknowledgement
Project compliance tracker updated with submission date and status
ESG metrics updated if report includes environmental or sustainability data

label: Update Schedule Baseline
description: Re-baseline the project schedule following an approved change order or recovery plan.
confirmationMessage: Re-baselining the schedule will reset all earned value calculations and variance tracking. This requires Project Director approval. Proceed with the re-baseline request?

crossDomainEffects.effect: New baseline stored and all SPI/CPI metrics recalculated from new reference
Updated milestone dates distributed to field teams and subcontractors
Cash flow forecast updated to align with revised schedule milestones

label: Log Partnership Milestone
description: Record a key milestone or decision point in a strategic partnership or joint venture relationship.
confirmationMessage: This milestone will be added to the partnership record and visible to all stakeholders with partnership access. Proceed?

crossDomainEffects.effect: Partnership timeline updated and stakeholder notifications triggered
Joint venture financial tracking updated if milestone has revenue implications

label: Reject Subcontractor Claim
description: Formally reject a subcontractor claim with documented justification and contractual references.
confirmationMessage: Rejecting this claim will formally notify the subcontractor with your stated reasons. Ensure the rejection is supported by contractual evidence. The subcontractor may escalate to dispute resolution. Proceed?

crossDomainEffects.effect: Claim status updated to rejected and removed from accrued liabilities
Claim rejection letter generated and logged in contract administration records
Subcontractor claims history updated for performance tracking

label: Generate Executive Report
description: Compile and generate a consolidated executive performance report from all connected source systems.
confirmationMessage: This will generate a consolidated report pulling data from all connected systems. The report will be available in the executive dashboard within 5 minutes. Generate now?

crossDomainEffects.effect: Project performance data extracted and consolidated into report template
Financial KPIs and budget data pulled for the reporting period
Schedule performance metrics and milestone status extracted
Workforce utilization and capacity data included in report

label: Update ESG Metrics
description: Update environmental, social, and governance metrics for a project including carbon emissions and sustainability scores.
confirmationMessage: Updating ESG metrics will recalculate the project sustainability score and may affect compliance status. Ensure data has been verified by the sustainability team. Proceed?

crossDomainEffects.effect: Sustainability dashboard updated with new metrics and trend recalculated
Project environmental compliance status refreshed
Regulatory reporting data flagged for update if thresholds are affected

label: Create Revenue Forecast
description: Generate a revenue forecast model based on current pipeline, win probabilities, and contract backlog.
confirmationMessage: This will create a new revenue forecast snapshot based on current pipeline data. The forecast will be shared with the finance team for consolidation. Proceed?

crossDomainEffects.effect: Forecast snapshot saved with weighted pipeline values and probability adjustments
Revenue projection data shared with financial planning for budget alignment
